description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kadurupe, Rathgama D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No.810155 (24/0209).
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
